basic_details.job_title: AMSCL Procurement Expert Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.post_name: Procurement Expert (Drugs & Supply Chain Management), Procurement Expert (Equipment & Services)
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: Procurement Expert (Drugs & Supply Chain Management): B.Pharm/M.Pharm plus Post Graduate qualification (MBA/PGDM in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Healthcare Management, or equivalent). Procurement Expert (Equipment & Services): Bachelor Degree in Instrumentation/Bio-Medical Engineering/Medical Electronics plus the same Post Graduate qualification. Minimum 8 years of experience for both posts.

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: B.Pharm/M.Pharm from a recognized institution; Post Graduate qualification (MBA/PGDM in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Healthcare Management, or equivalent) is required. Experience required: Minimum 8 years of experience in procurement, contract management and supply chain management of large-scale procurement of drugs, medicines, vaccines and medical consumables in the public sector, government organizations, PSU, multilateral agencies, or large healthcare organizations, with at least 5 years in a senior managerial position handling pharmaceutical/drug procurement and healthcare supply chain management. Age limit: Maximum 50 years. Pay: Rs.80,000. Qualification required: Bachelor Degree in Instrumentation/Bio-Medical Engineering/Medical Electronics from Govt.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs.80,000 per month for both posts

how_to_apply: Apply online on the AMSCL, Assam website https://amscl.assam.gov.in.
Online application will be received till 30th November 2026.
important_instructions: The undersigned reserves the right to reject any or all applications without assigning any reasons Applicants are advised to visit the website for the interview / selection test schedule

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: B.Pharm/M.Pharm from a recognized institution; Post Graduate qualification (MBA/PGDM in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Healthcare Management, or equivalent) is required. Experience required: Minimum 8 years of experience in procurement, contract management and supply chain management of large-scale procurement of drugs, medicines, vaccines and medical consumables in the public sector, government organizations, PSU, multilateral agencies, or large healthcare organizations, with at least 5 years in a senior managerial position handling pharmaceutical/drug procurement and healthcare supply chain management. Age limit: Maximum 50 years. Pay: Rs.80,000. Qualification required: Bachelor Degree in Instrumentation/Bio-Medical Engineering/Medical Electronics from Govt. recognized Institution/University; Post Graduate qualification (MBA/PGDM in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Healthcare Management, or equivalent) is required. Experience required: Minimum 8 years of experience in procurement, contract management, supply chain management, or project management in Government sector / PSU / reputed autonomous bodies / multilateral funded projects / large healthcare organizations, with at least 5 years in a senior managerial position handling procurement of medical equipment, hospital infrastructure, or related services. Age limit: Maximum 50 years. Pay: Rs.80,000.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Engagement on contractual basis in mission mode The number of vacancies may vary at the time of recruitment

content_sections.heading: How Will AMSCL Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Provisional shortlisting of candidates Interview / selection test The schedule of interview / selection test will be published on https://amscl.assam.gov.in along with the list of provisionally shortlisted candidates No separate individual call letter for interview / selection test will be sent No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview / selection test

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AMSCL Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply online on the AMSCL, Assam website https://amscl.assam.gov.in. Online application will be received till 30th November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AMSCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AMSCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Procurement Expert (Drugs & Supply Chain Management), 1 Procurement Expert (Equipment & Services).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for AMSCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 50 years (as on 1 January 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC/MOBC 3 years, PwD 10 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs.80,000 for Procurement Expert (Drugs & Supply Chain Management), Rs.80,000 for Procurement Expert (Equipment & Services).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Procurement Expert (Drugs & Supply Chain Management): B.Pharm/M.Pharm plus Post Graduate qualification (MBA/PGDM in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Healthcare Management, or equivalent). Procurement Expert (Equipment & Services): Bachelor Degree in Instrumentation/Bio-Medical Engineering/Medical Electronics plus the same Post Graduate qualification. Minimum 8 years of experience for both posts. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Computer proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Knowledge of the GFR, CVC Guidelines and State specific Procurement Acts & Rules.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates without the requisite qualification need not apply.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Provisional shortlisting of candidates. Interview / selection test. The schedule of interview / selection test will be published on https://amscl.assam.gov.in along with the list of provisionally shortlisted candidates. No separate individual call letter for interview / selection test will be sent.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement on contractual basis in mission mode. The number of vacancies may vary at the time of recruitment.
